## Transform Overview

Fortescue: Decomposes by ROTATION DIRECTION
  → Spin basis (circular polarization states)
  → Uses COMPLEX numbers
  → Eigenstates of angular momentum
  
Park: Rotates measurement frame by angle θ
  → Used for projecting onto detector axis  
  → Uses REAL coordinates
  → Converts oscillating to constant (if synchronized)
  
Clarke: Projects onto stationary 2D axes
  → Like standard x-y coordinates
  → Uses REAL coordinates
  → Special case of Park with θ=0
